name: Kingfish Limited
sector: Listed Investment Company / NZ Equities Fund
quirks: Closed-end listed investment company (LIC) managed by Fisher Funds -- no revenue, EBITDA or FCF; valued on NAV compounding x exit price-to-NAV, not an FCF DCF.
Filings in THOUSANDS NZD; EPS reported in CENTS.
NAV per share FELL $1.57 (FY2019) -> $1.20 (FY2026) while shares on issue rose 81% via warrants and the DRP; the 2%-of-NAV-per-quarter (~8%/yr) distribution is largely return of capital.
CSV 'Revenue' column is total income INCLUDING mark-to-market and is negative in FY2022/FY2023/FY2026 -- never log-scale it.
Zero borrowings: total_debt is 0 every year; net assets ARE the NAV.
